verses.en: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.pt: E havia em Antioquia, na igreja que estava ali, alguns profetas e mestres: Barnabé e Simeão, chamado Níger, e Lúcio cireneu, e Manaem, que tinha sido criado na infância junto com Herodes o Tetrarca, e Saulo.
verses.en_web: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.en_bbe: Now there were at Antioch, in the church there, prophets and teachers, Barnabas, and Symeon who was named Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, a relation of Herod the king, and Saul.

verses.en: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.pt: E tendo eles prestado serviço ao Senhor, e jejuado, o Espirito Santo disse: Separai-me a Barnabé e a Saulo, para a obra para a qual eu os tenho chamado.
verses.en_web: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”
verses.en_bbe: And while they were doing the Lord's work, and going without food, the Holy Spirit said, Let Barnabas and Saul be given to me for the special work for which they have been marked out by me.

verses.en: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.pt: Então jejuando, e orando, e pondo as mãos sobre eles, os despediram.
verses.en_web: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.en_bbe: Then, after prayer and going without food they put their hands on them, and sent them away.

verses.en: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.pt: Portanto estes, enviados pelo Espírito Santo, desceram a Selêucia, e dali navegaram para o Chipre.
verses.en_web: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.en_bbe: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia; and from there they went by ship to Cyprus.

verses.en: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
verses.pt: E tendo chegado a Salamina, anunciavam a palavra de Deus nas sinagogas dos judeus; e também tinham a João como trabalhador para os auxiliar.
verses.en_web: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They had also John as their attendant.
verses.en_bbe: And at Salamis they were preaching the word of God in the Synagogues of the Jews: and John was with them, helping them.

verses.en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:
verses.pt: E tendo eles atravessado a Ilha até Pafo, acharam a um certo mago, falso profeta, judeu, cujo nome era Barjesus.
verses.en_web: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: And when they had gone through all the island to Paphos, they came across a certain wonder-worker and false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar-Jesus;

verses.en: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
verses.pt: O qual estava com o procônsul Sérgio Paulo, homem prudente. Este, tendo chamado a si a Barnabé, e a Saulo, procurava muito ouvir a palavra de Deus.
verses.en_web: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
verses.en_bbe: Who was with the ruler, Sergius Paulus, an able man. This man sent for Barnabas and Saul, desiring to have knowledge of the word of God.

verses.en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
verses.pt: Mas resistia-lhes Elimas, o mago (que assim significa seu nome), procurando afastar o procônsul da fé.
verses.en_web: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
verses.en_bbe: But Elymas, the wonder-worker (for that is the sense of his name), put himself against them, with the purpose of turning the ruler from the faith.

verses.en: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
verses.pt: Mas Saulo, que também se chama Paulo, cheio do Espírito Santo, e olhando fixamente para ele, disse:
verses.en_web: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him,
verses.en_bbe: But Saul, whose other name is Paul, being full of the Holy Spirit, looking hard at him, said,

verses.en: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.pt: Ó filho do diabo, cheio de toda enganação e toda malícia, inimigo de toda justiça, não cessarás de perverter os corretos caminhos do Senhor?
verses.en_web: and said, “Full of all deceit and all cunning, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.en_bbe: O you, who are full of false tricks and evil ways, a son of the Evil One, hating all righteousness, will you for ever be turning people from the right ways of the Lord?

verses.en: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.pt: E agora, eis que a mão do Senhor está contra ti, e serás cego, não vendo o sol por algum tempo.E no mesmo instante caiu sobre ele um embaçamento, e trevas; e ele, andando ao redor, procurava alguém que o guiasse pela mão.
verses.en_web: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
verses.en_bbe: And now, see, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind and not able to see the sun for a time. And straight away a dark mist came down on him; and he went about looking for a guide.

verses.en: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
verses.pt: Então o procônsul, vendo o que tinha acontecido, creu, espantado pela doutrina do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Then the ruler, when he saw what was done, had faith, being full of wonder at the teaching of the Lord.

verses.en: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
verses.pt: E tendo partido de Pafo, Paulo e os que estavam com ele foram a Perges, cidade da Panfília. Mas João, separando-se deles, voltou a Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: Then Paul and those who were with him went by ship from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia: and there John went away from them and came back to Jerusalem.

verses.en: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.pt: E eles, tendo passado de Perges, vieram a Antioquia, cidade da Pisídia; e ao entrarem na sinagoga n um dia de sábado, sentaram-se.
verses.en_web: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.en_bbe: But they, going through from Perga, came to Antioch in Pisidia; and they went into the Synagogue on the Sabbath and were seated.

verses.en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.pt: E depois da leitura da Lei e dos profetas, os chefes da sinagoga lhes mandaram, dizendo: Homens irmãos, se em vós há alguma palavra de exortação ao povo, dizei.
verses.en_web: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
verses.en_bbe: And after the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the Synagogue sent to them, saying, Brothers, if you have a word of comfort for the people, say on.

verses.en: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
verses.pt: E Paulo, levantando-se e fazendo gesto com a mão, disse: Homens israelitas, e vós os que temeis a Deus, ouvi:
verses.en_web: Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
verses.en_bbe: And Paul, getting up and making a sign with his hand, said, Men of Israel, and you who have the fear of God, give ear.

verses.en: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
verses.pt: O Deus deste povo de Israel escolheu a nossos pais, e exaltou ao povo, sendo eles estrangeiros na terra do Egito, e com o braço levantando, ele os tirou dela.
verses.en_web: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
verses.en_bbe: The God of this people Israel made selection of our fathers, lifting the people up from their low condition when they were living in the land of Egypt, and with a strong arm took them out of it.

verses.en: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
verses.pt: E pelo tempo de cerca de quarenta anos, ele suportou os costumes deles no deserto.
verses.en_web: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: And for about forty years he put up with their ways in the waste land.

verses.en: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
verses.pt: E tendo destruído a sete nações na terra de Canaã, repartiu-lhes as terras por sorte.
verses.en_web: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred fifty years.
verses.en_bbe: And having put to destruction seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them the land for their heritage for about four hundred and fifty years.

verses.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.pt: E depois disto, cerca de quatrocentos e cinquenta anos, ele lhes deu juízes, até o profeta Samuel.
verses.en_web: After these things he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
verses.en_bbe: And after these things he gave them judges, till the time of Samuel the prophet.

verses.en: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
verses.pt: E depois disto, pediram a um Rei, e ele lhes deu a Saul, filho de Quis, homem da tribo de Benjamim, durante quarenta anos.
verses.en_web: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
verses.en_bbe: Then at their request for a king, God gave them Saul, the son of Kish, a man of the family of Benjamin, who was their king for forty years.

verses.en: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
verses.pt: E tirando a este, levantou-lhes por rei a Davi, ao qual também deu testemunho, e disse: Eu achei a Davi, filho de Jessé, um homem conforme o meu coração, que fará toda a minha vontade.
verses.en_web: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
verses.en_bbe: And having put him on one side, he made David their king, to whom he gave witness, saying, I have taken David, the son of Jesse, a man dear to my heart, who will do all my pleasure.

verses.en: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
verses.pt: Da descendência deste, conforme a promessa, Deus levantou a Jesus por Salvador de Israel;
verses.en_web: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
verses.en_bbe: From this man's seed has God given to Israel a Saviour, even Jesus, as he gave his word;

verses.en: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.pt: Tendo João primeiro, antes de sua vinda, pregado o batismo de arrependimento a todo o povo de Israel.
verses.en_web: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
verses.en_bbe: For whose coming John made ready the way by preaching to all the people of Israel the baptism which goes with a change of heart.

verses.en: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
verses.pt: Mas quando João cumpriu sua carreira, disse: Quem vós pensais que eu sou? Eu não sou o Cristo,mas eis que após mim vem aquele, cujas sandálias dos pés eu não sou digno de desatar.
verses.en_web: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
verses.en_bbe: And when John was completing his work, he said, What do I seem to you to be? I am not he; but one is coming after me, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo.

verses.en: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
verses.pt: Homens irmãos, filhos da descendência de Abraão, e os que dentre vós temem a Deus, a vós é enviada a palavra desta salvação.
verses.en_web: Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
verses.en_bbe: My brothers, children of the family of Abraham, and those among you who have the fear of God, to us the word of this salvation is sent.

verses.en: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
verses.pt: Porque os que habitavam em Jerusalém, e seus líderes, não conhecendo a este, ao condenarem -no,cumpriram as vozes dos profetas, que são lidas todos os sábados.
verses.en_web: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
verses.en_bbe: For the men of Jerusalem and their rulers, having no knowledge of him, or of the sayings of the prophets which come to their ears every Sabbath day, gave effect to them by judging him.

verses.en: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.pt: E mesmo achando nenhum motivo para morte, pediram a Pilatos que fosse morto.
verses.en_web: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
verses.en_bbe: And though no cause of death was seen in him, they made a request to Pilate that he might be put to death.

verses.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
verses.pt: E tendo eles cumprido todas as coisas que estavam escritas sobre ele, tirando -o do madeiro, puseram -no na sepultura.
verses.en_web: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had done all the things said in the Writings about him, they took him down from the tree, and put him in the place of the dead.

verses.en: But God raised him from the dead:
verses.pt: Mas Deus o ressuscitou dos mortos.
verses.en_web: But God raised him from the dead,
verses.en_bbe: But God gave him back from the dead:

verses.en: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
verses.pt: O qual foi visto durante muitos dias pelos que haviam subido com ele da Galileia, que são suas testemunhas para com o povo.
verses.en_web: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
verses.en_bbe: And for a number of days he was seen by those who came with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now his witnesses before the people.

verses.en: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
verses.pt: E nós vos anunciamos o Evangelho da promessa que foi feita aos pais; ao qual Deus já nos cumpriu a nós, filhos deles, ressuscitando a Jesus.
verses.en_web: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
verses.en_bbe: And we are giving you the good news of the undertaking made to the fathers,

verses.en: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.pt: Assim como está escrito no salmo segundo: Tu és meu Filho, hoje eu te gerei.
verses.en_web: that God has fulfilled the same to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
verses.en_bbe: Which God has now put into effect for our children, by sending Jesus; as it says in the second Psalm, You are my Son; this day I have given you being.

verses.en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
verses.pt: E quanto a que o ressuscitasse dos mortos, para nunca mais voltar à degradação, assim disse: Eu vos darei as fiéis beneficências de Davi.
verses.en_web: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
verses.en_bbe: And about his coming back from the dead, never again to go to destruction, he has said these words, I will give you the holy and certain mercies of David.

verses.en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.pt: Por isso que também em outro salmo ele diz: Não permitirás que teu Santo veja degradação.
verses.en_web: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
verses.en_bbe: Because he says in another Psalm, You will not let your Holy One see destruction.

verses.en: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
verses.pt: Porque, na verdade, tendo Davi servido ao conselho de Deus, morreu, foi posto junto a seus pais, e viu degradação.
verses.en_web: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, and was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
verses.en_bbe: Now David, having done God's work for his generation, went to sleep, and was put with his fathers, and his body came to destruction:

verses.en: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
verses.pt: Mas aquele a quem Deus ressuscitou nenhuma degradação viu.
verses.en_web: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
verses.en_bbe: But he, who was lifted up by God, did not see destruction.

verses.en: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
verses.pt: Seja-vos pois conhecido, homens irmãos, que por este vos é anunciado o perdão dos pecados.
verses.en_web: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins,
verses.en_bbe: And so, let it be clear to you, my brothers, that through this man forgiveness of sins is offered to you:

verses.en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.pt: E de tudo o que pela lei de Moisés não pudestes ser justificados, neste é justificado todo aquele que crê.
verses.en_web: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.en_bbe: And through him everyone who has faith is made free from all those things, from which the law of Moses was not able to make you free.

verses.en: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
verses.pt: Então vede, para que não venha sobre vós o que está escrito nos livros dos profetas:
verses.en_web: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
verses.en_bbe: So take care that these words of the prophets do not come true for you;

verses.en: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
verses.pt: Vós desprezadores, vede e espantai-vos, e desaparecei-vos; porque eu opero obra em vossos dias, obra na qual não crereis, se alguém vos contar.
verses.en_web: ‘Behold, you scoffers, and wonder, and perish; for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”
verses.en_bbe: See, you doubters, have wonder and come to your end; for I will do a thing in your days to which you will not give belief, even if it is made clear to you.

verses.en: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
verses.pt: E tendo os judeus saído da sinagoga,os gentios rogaram -lhes que no sábado seguinte eles lhes falassem estas palavras.
verses.en_web: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
verses.en_bbe: And when they went out, they made a request that these words might be said to them again on the Sabbath after.

verses.en: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.pt: E tendo terminado a reunião da sinagoga, muitos dos judeus, e dos religiosos prosélitos, seguiram a Paulo e a Barnabé; os quais, falando-lhes, exortavam-nos a permanecerem na graça de Deus.
verses.en_web: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.en_bbe: Now when the meeting was ended, a number of the Jews and of the God-fearing Gentiles who had become Jews, went after Paul and Barnabas: who put before them how important it was to keep on in the grace of God.

verses.en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
verses.pt: E no sábado seguinte ajuntou-se quase toda a cidade para ouvir a palavra de Deus.
verses.en_web: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
verses.en_bbe: And on the Sabbath after, almost all the town came together to give hearing to the word of God.

verses.en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
verses.pt: Mas os Judeus, ao verem as multidões, ficaram cheios de inveja, e falavam contrariamente ao que Paulo dizia, falando contrariamente e blasfemando.
verses.en_web: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
verses.en_bbe: But when the Jews saw such a great number of people, they were full of envy and said evil words against Paul's preaching.

verses.en: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.pt: Mas Paulo e Barnabé, usando de ousadia, disseram: Era necessário que a palavra de Deus fosse primeiro falada a vós; mas já que a rejeitais, e não vos julgais dignos da vida eterna, eis que nós nos viramos em direção aos gentios.
verses.en_web: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.en_bbe: Then Paul and Barnabas without fear said, It was necessary for the word of God to be given to you first; but because you will have nothing to do with it, and have no desire for eternal life, it will now be offered to the Gentiles.

verses.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.pt: Porque assim o Senhor nos mandou, dizendo: Eu te pus como luz para os gentios, para que tu sejas como salvação até às extremidades da terra.
verses.en_web: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”
verses.en_bbe: For so the Lord has given us orders, saying, I have given you for a light to the Gentiles so that you may be for salvation to the ends of the earth.

verses.en: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.pt: E os gentios, tendo ouvido isto,alegraram-se, e glorificavam ao Senhor; e creram todos quantos estavam determinados para a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
verses.en_bbe: And the Gentiles, hearing this, were glad and gave glory to the word of God: and those marked out by God for eternal life had faith.

verses.en: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
verses.pt: E a palavra do Senhor era divulgada por toda aquela região.
verses.en_web: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord went through all the country.

verses.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
verses.pt: Mas os judeus incitaram algumas mulheres devotas e honradas, e aos líderes da cidade, e levantaram perseguição contra Paulo e Barnabé, e os expulsaram de seus limites.
verses.en_web: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
verses.en_bbe: But the Jews, working up the feelings of the God-fearing women of high position and of the chief men of the town, got an attack started against Paul and Barnabas, driving them out of those parts.

verses.en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
verses.pt: Mas eles, sacudindo contra eles o pó dos seus pés, vieram a Icônio.
verses.en_web: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
verses.en_bbe: But they, shaking off the dust of that place from their feet, came to Iconium.

verses.en: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: E os discípulos se enchiam de alegria e do Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: And the disciples were full of joy and of the Holy Spirit.
